# Acronyms {.unnumbered}

- **AD**: Alzheimer's Disease
- **ADAS-13**: Alzheimer's Disease Assessment Scale -- 13 Item
- **ADNI**: Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
- **ANIMAL**: Automatic Nonlinear Image Matching and
  Anatomical Labeling
- **APOE**: Apolipoprotein E
- **BCCG**: Box-Cox Cole and Green (distribution)
- **CFA**: Confirmatory Factor Analysis
- **CFI**: Comparative Fit Index
- **CNN**: Convolutional Neural Network
- **CSF**: Cerebrospinal Fluid
- **CVD**: Cardiovascular Disease
- **CVR**: Cardiovascular Risk
- **DARQ**: Deep Automated Registration QC
- **DBM**: Deformation-Based Morphometry
- **DG**: Dentate Gyrus
- **DSC**: Dice Similarity Coefficient
- **FIML**: Full Information Maximum Likelihood
- **FLAIR**: Fluid-Attenuated Inversion Recovery
- **FRS**: Framingham Risk Score
- **GAMLSS**: Generalized Additive Models for Location,
  Scale, and Shape
- **HC**: Hippocampus
- **HCvol**: Hippocampal Volume
- **HDL**: High-Density Lipoprotein
- **HOC**: Hippocampal Occupancy Score
- **HPA**: Hypothalamic-Pituitary-Adrenal (axis)
- **HVR**: Hippocampal-to-Ventricle Ratio
- **ICV**: Intracranial Volume
- **IQMs**: Image Quality Metrics
- **LGCM**: Latent Growth Curve Model
- **LME**: Linear Mixed-Effects (model)
- **MALF**: Multi-Atlas Label Fusion
- **MCI**: Mild Cognitive Impairment
- **MIMIC**: Multiple Indicators Multiple Causes (model)
- **MMSE**: Mini-Mental State Examination
- **MRI**: Magnetic Resonance Imaging
- **MRIQC**: MR Image Quality Classifier
- **NFTs**: Neurofibrillary Tangles
- **NIA-AA**: National Institute on Aging and Alzheimer's
  Association
- **NLPB**: Non-Local Patch-Based (segmentation)
- **NPH**: Normal Pressure Hydrocephalus
- **PET**: Positron Emission Tomography
- **QC**: Quality Control
- **RAVLT**: Rey Auditory Verbal Learning Test
- **RMSEA**: Root Mean Square Error of Approximation
- **SEM**: Structural Equation Modeling
- **SRMR**: Standardized Root Mean Square Residual
- **STAPLE**: Simultaneous Truth and Performance Level
  Estimation
- **TLI**: Tucker-Lewis Index
- **UKB**: UK Biobank
- **WMH**: White Matter Hyperintensities
- **WLSMV**: Weighted Least Squares Mean and Variance
  Adjusted
